instruction: Change the font color to dark red for all words that are 5 letters or longer. This will highlight the longer words.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Verified by analyzing all 52 words: 7 words have 5+ letters

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly handles LibreOffice Writer's run-based formatting model by checking formatting at the run level rather than word level
Three-case logic properly addresses different scenarios: (1) runs with only long words must be dark red, (2) runs with only short words must not be dark red, (3) mixed runs are handled leniently
Color matching uses appropriate tolerance (±15 RGB) for dark red detection
Sanity checks ensure at least some long words exist and at least 50% of runs with long words are formatted
Postconfig correctly saves the document before verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing the partial credit threshold from 50% to 70-80% to ensure more complete task completion

Mixed-run handling (lines 102-110) could be stricter: currently accepts both red and non-red formatting for runs containing both long and short words. Consider requiring red formatting if the majority of words in the run are 5+ letters
Add validation that runs with only short words maintain reasonable formatting (not just 'not dark red' but also not arbitrary colors that might indicate errors)
